findings.evidence: The `empty` boundary row for `lem-locally-finite-linear-combinations-of-sections-are-smooth` says the item is not an empty-family claim, but the statement quantifies over families `(\sigma_i)_{i\in I}` and `(f_i)_{i\in I}`. When `I=\varnothing`, the pointwise sum is the zero section, so an empty-family branch does exist.

The published verification text has citation tokens spliced into the claim prose (`in [F1]`, `by [F2, step 1.1]`, `so [F3] makes [F3, step 2.1]`), so the dependency remains readable only by reconstruction rather than as well-formed proof steps.
